Build study · Founder beside counterpart

The Business Partner Beside the Name

The person beside the name can carry finance, operations, relationships, governance, contradiction, and continuity—capacity that should be documented rather than erased as support.

Read the exhibition

00

The proposition

Fashion’s public grammar places one name on the label, yet a durable house may depend on a business partner who translates ambition into cash flow, contracts, production capacity, hiring, distribution, controls, and difficult refusals. Public corporate filings can reveal titles, board structures, voting arrangements, and executive duties, but those records do not measure trust, taste, informal influence, or invisible care.

The institutional task is to map the partnership without manufacturing a second heroic myth. Creative, executive, board, voting, economic, employment, and relational authority are distinct. Under Delaware corporate law, board authority has a defined statutory frame for Delaware corporations; actual power also depends on governing documents, agreements, facts, and jurisdiction. A partner map must therefore bind each claimed authority to evidence and send disputed legal questions to counsel.

The institutional sequence

01 · CAPACITY

What burden leaves the founder?

Name the decisions, relationships, records, calendars, risks, and emotional labor the partner carries. Replace “business side” with observable work and consequences.

INFERENCES35S36

02 · AUTHORITY

What may each person decide?

Write decision rights as verb plus object, threshold, required consultation, override, evidence, and appeal. Separate custom from enforceable authority.

VERIFIEDS50S51S52

03 · ECONOMICS

How are value and downside shared?

Map equity, votes, salary, royalty, bonus, expenses, guarantees, vesting, transfer, dilution, information, and exit separately. Public filings are examples, not templates.

INFERENCES36S37

04 · BREAK

What happens when alignment ends?

Run deadlock, incapacity, departure, nonperformance, acquisition, founder conflict, and reputational crisis through the actual governance and contract records with qualified counsel.

PROPOSALS49S50S52

COUNTERPOINT

What this framework could get wrong

Celebrating the operational partner can obscure staff, workers, advisers, and communities who also carry the institution. Conversely, romanticizing founder chemistry can hide unequal economics or undocumented authority. Precision makes collaboration visible without pretending harmony.

FIELDWORK

Do the work now

Use this as a working session, not a score.

  1. List every recurring decision and who actually makes, advises, approves, records, and can reverse it.
  2. Attach corporate, contract, account, and practice evidence separately.
  3. Map economics and information access without assuming title equals value.
  4. Review seven rupture scenarios with corporate, employment, tax, and IP counsel as relevant.

Reading protocol

Every material statement carries an evidence label and point-of-claim source links. Interpretation is never presented as source fact. Legal sections identify their jurisdiction; state, foreign, contractual, beneficial-ownership, validity, priority, and disputed-fact questions remain counsel-review gates. This exhibition is educational and does not provide legal, conservation, or business advice.
